issue_failure_class_map — 4 of 6 Governance issues (CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS, POLICY_FAILURE, DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN, MILITARY_OVERREACH) grounded in each issue's OWN canonical circuit detail and/or summary text. 2 of 6 (REGIME_INSTABILITY, CORRUPTION_SCANDAL) marked UNMAPPED.

heterogeneity_flagged: ADVERSARIAL / INSTITUTIONAL-INTEGRITY SHARE IS THE HEADLINE. Governance carries TWO failure archetypes the E/I-dynamics taxonomy structurally cannot represent (Finance carried one, FRAUD_SCANDAL). (a) CORRUPTION_SCANDAL = regulatory capture / self-dealing / bribery — a deliberate corruption of institutional integrity, the direct governance analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL. (b) REGIME_INSTABILITY = erosion of political LEGITIMACY / loss of authorization plus coups and mass protest — a socially-conferred-legitimacy failure with an adversarial-collective-action component. Neither is an excitation/inhibition/gating/clearance/synchrony/propagation failure; both are marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

CORRUPTION_SCANDAL canonical node cue is NAcc[Hyper] 'incentive/reward drive — over-pursuit=bubble', which superficially reads as reward-runaway (SEIZURE-flavored). That cue was NOT used: the ESSENCE named by the issue's own summary and _authored circuit is CAPTURE ('regulatory oversight captured by the very interests it was designed to monitor'), kleptocratic extraction, bribery and quid-pro-quo — adversarial integrity failure, not reward dynamics. Force-fitting to SEIZURE would be the exact discipline violation the source forbids.

REGIME_INSTABILITY shares the vmPFC[Hypo] 'brake-fail=rogue' canonical cue with CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS and MILITARY_OVERREACH (three issues reuse the identical canonical circuit node), yet its OWN summary is dominantly legitimacy-erosion / turnover / coups. Classed on the summary (UNMAPPED), with the shared brake-fail cue noted as a canonical-node artifact, not the governing mechanism.

POLICY_FAILURE is grounded to INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT in the FUNCTIONAL sense (rPFC 'no-foresight, myopic' plus dACC 'regulatory feedback loops broken, preventing detection and correction' = loss of the predictive/feedback control arm). This DIVERGES from the structural incomplete-circuit test below, which finds the arm STRUCTURALLY present (vmPFC, HIPP, dACC) and returns 'complete'. The two diagnostics are independent: a circuit can be structurally complete yet functionally open-loop. Divergence recorded, not resolved by guessing.

DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN classed on its SUMMARY ('collapse of channels... isolation') as DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS; its canonical NODE cue (TPJ 'mindblindness', a social-cognition processing deficit) points at a different flavor. Divergence recorded. Separately, DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN is the ONE issue that FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner in its _authored circuit).
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Governance-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, marking UNMAPPED where no dynamical analog exists, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Governance issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in governance_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 dynamical classes (adversarial / institutional-integrity / legitimacy failure), it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.
issue_failure_class_map._count: 4 grounded, 2 UNMAPPED (of 6 issues). Governance's UNMAPPED share (2/6) is DOUBLE Finance's (1/6): institutional-integrity/adversarial failure is a larger part of the governance failure surface.

CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue runaway (loss of the stop/brake)
CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS.governance_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored dlPFC[Hyper-active]: "Executive authority expanding beyond constitutional bounds without effective constraint"; summary: "branches of government exceed their authority"
CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the loss of the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE ('brake-fail=rogue'), and the _authored dominant node is the executive 'expanding beyond constitutional bounds without effective constraint'. One node escaping the inhibitory partner and running rogue is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.
CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS.note: Summary also carries a legitimacy element ('refuse to recognize the legitimacy of other branches'); classed on the dominant named mechanism (brake-fail + unconstrained executive expansion), which is dynamical disinhibition. Legitimacy overlay flagged, not force-fit.

REGIME_INSTABILITY.reason: Issue's own summary names an INSTITUTIONAL-INTEGRITY / legitimacy failure with an adversarial-collective-action component, with no analog among the 9 dynamical Part XIV classes.
REGIME_INSTABILITY.governance_text: summary: "Erosion of political legitimacy leading to frequent government turnover, coups, mass protests, or civil unrest"; canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored NAcc[Altered]: "Electoral reward mechanisms distorted by voter disillusionment"
REGIME_INSTABILITY.reasoning: 'Erosion of political legitimacy' is loss of a SOCIALLY-CONFERRED authorization to govern; coups and mass protest are adversarial collective action. The 9 classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses loss-of-legitimacy or adversarial delegitimation. Forcing it into DISINHIBITION on the shared vmPFC brake-fail cue would misrepresent the failure (the brake-fail cue is reused verbatim across three issues and is a canonical-node artifact here, not the governing mechanism named by THIS issue's summary). Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
REGIME_INSTABILITY.note: One of TWO governance heterogeneity findings. Together with CORRUPTION_SCANDAL, it doubles Finance's single UNMAPPED (FRAUD_SCANDAL).

POLICY_FAILURE.subtype: functional open-loop: lost prediction (foresight) + lost feedback (error-correction), regulatory arm present-but-hypofunctional
POLICY_FAILURE.governance_text: canonical circuit rPFC[Hypo]: "frontopolar PFC — metacognition & prospective control — no-foresight, myopic"; _authored dACC[Hypo-active]: "Regulatory feedback loops broken, preventing detection and correction of policy failures"; _authored vmPFC[Hypo-active]: "Policy valuation and cost-benefit analysis degraded"
POLICY_FAILURE.reasoning: The named mechanism is loss of prospective/predictive control ('no-foresight, myopic') PLUS an explicitly broken feedback/error-correction loop ('feedback loops broken, preventing detection and correction'). A circuit that has lost its feedback/predictive arm is the INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT archetype ('feedback without the sensor... any regulatory arm omitted'). This is a competence/capacity failure (not adversarial, not deception), so it IS mappable to a dynamical class.
POLICY_FAILURE.note: DIVERGES FROM THE STRUCTURAL TEST BELOW ON PURPOSE: incomplete_circuit_diagnostic finds POLICY_FAILURE's _authored arm STRUCTURALLY present (vmPFC, HIPP, dACC) and returns 'complete'. Here the arm is present-but-HYPOFUNCTIONAL (functional incompleteness). The failure-class diagnostic and the structural test are independent, exactly as Finance flagged for FRAUD_SCANDAL. An alternative reading is GATING_FAILURE ('gridlock/paralysis' = freeze) if grounding on the pulse-engine label 'Policy Failure / Gridlock', but governance.json's OWN canonical cue is 'no-foresight, myopic', not a gate-lock, so INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT (functional) is the honest grounded fit.

CORRUPTION_SCANDAL.reason: Issue text names an ADVERSARIAL / institutional-integrity failure (regulatory capture, self-dealing, bribery) with NO analog among the 9 dynamical Part XIV classes. Direct governance parallel of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.
CORRUPTION_SCANDAL.governance_text: canonical circuit NAcc[Hyper]: "incentive/reward drive — over-pursuit=bubble"; summary: "Systemic corruption... public office is exploited for private gain, eroding institutional trust"; _authored dACC[Hypo-active]: "Regulatory oversight captured by the very interests it was designed to monitor"; _authored STRI[Hyper-active]: "diverted toward rent-seeking and kleptocratic extraction"
CORRUPTION_SCANDAL.reasoning: Capture, self-dealing, bribery and quid-pro-quo describe a deliberate corruption of institutional integrity — fiduciary betrayal, not a dynamical failure. The canonical NAcc[Hyper] 'over-pursuit=bubble' cue reads superficially as reward-runaway (SEIZURE flavor), but the issue's own summary and _authored circuit name CAPTURE as the essence, which no dynamical archetype represents. Force-fitting to SEIZURE would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
CORRUPTION_SCANDAL.note: THE KEY GOVERNANCE HETEROGENEITY FINDING and the closest structural twin of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL (there: OFC 'confabulation' cue -> UNMAPPED; here: NAcc 'over-pursuit' cue -> UNMAPPED). The neuro-substrate E/I taxonomy cannot represent corruption/capture any more than it can represent fraud/deception.

DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN.subtype: loss of connectivity -> node isolated from the network
DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN.governance_text: summary: "Collapse of international diplomatic channels leading to isolation"; _authored TPJ[Hypo-active]: "Perspective-taking and empathic modeling of foreign state interests severely diminished"; _authored AG[Hypo-active]: "International legal frameworks abandoned... removing structural basis for cooperation"; canonical circuit TPJ[Hypo]: "temporoparietal junction — social attribution & reorienting — mindblindness"
DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN.reasoning: 'Collapse of channels' and 'isolation' are definitionally a loss of the node's connections to the rest of the network. Losing input/connectivity so that a node is functionally isolated from the graph is the DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS archetype (losing input disables a node and its distant partners; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure). Diplomatic isolation maps to deafferentation of the state from the international network.
DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN.note: Classed on the SUMMARY. The canonical NODE cue ('mindblindness', a TPJ social-cognition processing deficit) points at a different flavor (an input-processing/gating deficit); this node-cue-vs-summary divergence is flagged, not resolved by guessing. SEPARATELY: this is the one issue whose _authored circuit FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner) — see incomplete_circuit_diagnostic.

MILITARY_OVERREACH.subtype: brake-fail -> one subsystem escapes its constraint and dominates
MILITARY_OVERREACH.governance_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored SMA[Hyper-active]: "Military command structure expanding beyond defense mandate into political and economic domains"; _authored BROCA[Hypo-active]: "Legislative oversight of military operations weakened"
MILITARY_OVERREACH.reasoning: The named mechanism is loss of the top-down inhibitory brake (vmPFC brake-fail) with one subsystem (the military, SMA[Hyper]) 'expanding beyond mandate' while its oversight/constraint (BROCA[Hypo]) is weakened. One actor escaping the inhibitory constraint and running rogue is the DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME archetype (loss of the stop/brake). Mirrors CONSTITUTIONAL_CRISIS and Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.
MILITARY_OVERREACH.note: 'Politicization of the armed forces' carries an institutional overlay, but the dominant named mechanism (brake-fail + subsystem expanding without constraint) is dynamical disinhibition. Overlay flagged, not force-fit.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against governance.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: 5/6 complete, 1 INCOMPLETE. DIFFERS FROM FINANCE (6/6). DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN's _authored circuit (TPJ, AG, LANG, FPN, SMA, THAL) contains NO node from REGULATORY_NODES, so it fails the incomplete-circuit test — a genuinely lesioned circuit missing its regulatory/feedback arm. Its canonical single-node circuit (TPJ) is also non-regulatory, so it fails on BOTH canonical and _authored. Three other issues (POLICY_FAILURE canonical rPFC, CORRUPTION_SCANDAL canonical NAcc) have non-regulatory CANONICAL single-node circuits that would fail canonical-only, but their _authored multi-node circuits supply a regulatory partner and pass.

POLICY_FAILURE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is rPFC[Hypo] alone (frontopolar M5, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies vmPFC/HIPP/dACC. NOTE the independent divergence: this circuit is STRUCTURALLY complete here yet is classed INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT (functional open-loop) in issue_failure_class_map — the two diagnostics are independent.

CORRUPTION_SCANDAL.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is NAcc[Hyper] alone (reward drive, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies OFC/dACC. Circuit is structurally complete, yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (adversarial capture outside the 9-class taxonomy): structural completeness and failure-class mappability are independent.

DIPLOMATIC_BREAKDOWN.observation: THE ONE FAILURE. No node in the _authored circuit is in REGULATORY_NODES (TPJ, AG, LANG, FPN, SMA, THAL are all non-regulatory relay/output/language/social nodes). Canonical single-node circuit (TPJ) is also non-regulatory, so it fails on both. This circuit is lesioned in the Part XIV sense: it has no inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm. Consistent with the DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS class assigned (a de-afferented, poorly-regulated island).

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Finance mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
